verdict.rationale: Zulip documents high-quality export tools that let organizations export all their data (public and private with consent) and import it into another Zulip server or self-hosted instance, explicitly for migration/portability rather than lock-in, and Zulip is fully open-source/self-hostable so the underlying data format and code are open. Missing for 10: no explicit statement of the export file format's openness/standardization, and no independent hands-on report confirming a full data export+migration was performed successfully.
